answer: A sybil swarm must lock real capital per fake identity, and any gale of duplicate registrations gets slashed on challenge failure. Require each agent to stake bonded timber tokens plus solve a per-epoch cipher challenge derived from a verifiable random seed, so identities cannot be mass-farmed cheaply. Attack cost scales linearly with identity count, making capture economically irrational. From sa0007's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
